mainEntity.name: How do I know a DC dispensary or delivery service is legitimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for services that are transparent about how Initiative 71 works, require ID verification, and have a clear online presence with reviews. Avoid anything that does not ask for ID or that makes claims inconsistent with DC law.

mainEntity.name: Can I order delivery if I am visiting DC from out of state?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Initiative 71 applies to any adult 21 or older who is physically in DC. You do not need to be a DC resident. As long as you have a valid ID and a DC delivery address, you can order.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a medical and recreational dispensary in DC?

acceptedAnswer.text: DC has a separate licensed medical marijuana program for patients with a qualifying condition and a valid medical card. Recreational cannabis under Initiative 71 does not require a medical card and is available to any adult 21 or older.

children.html:
If you are trying to figure out where to buy weed in Washington, DC, you have two main options: visit a dispensary in person or order delivery online. Both are legal for adults 21 and older. Both give you access to quality cannabis. But the experience is different, and depending on your situation, one will suit you better than the other. Here is a straightforward breakdown of how each works in DC.

How Buying Weed Works in DC

Before getting into the comparison, it helps to understand how cannabis works in DC. Unlike states like Colorado or California, DC does not have a traditional licensed retail framework for recreational cannabis. Instead, recreational cannabis operates under Initiative 71, a voter-approved law that permits the gifting of cannabis between adults 21 and older.

This means that both dispensaries and delivery services in the recreational market operate within DC’s gifting model. The legal framework is the same regardless of whether you are buying in person or ordering online.

For a full explanation of Initiative 71, read: DC Weed Gifting: How Initiative 71 Works.

Option 1: Visiting a Dispensary in DC

DC has a well-established network of cannabis dispensaries operating under Initiative 71. Most operate as storefront locations where you can browse products and make a selection in person.

What to expect:

When you visit a DC dispensary, you will typically check in at the front, show your ID, and then be allowed to browse available products. Staff are usually on hand to answer questions and make recommendations. You pay, receive your cannabis as a gift under Initiative 71, and leave.

Best for:

  • People who prefer to see and ask about products in person before committing
  • Buyers who want immediate access without a delivery window
  • First-time buyers who want guidance from staff on the spot
  • People who happen to be near a dispensary and want to stop in

Things to keep in mind:

  • You need to travel to the location, which means parking, traffic, or transit
  • Some dispensaries have queues, especially during peak hours
  • Hours vary by location
  • Product selection varies by dispensary

Option 2: Ordering Weed Delivery in DC

Cannabis delivery in DC lets you order online and receive cannabis at your address within a few hours. Delivery services operate under the same Initiative 71 gifting framework as storefronts.

What to expect:

You browse the menu online, place your order, and a driver brings it to your address. Someone 21 or older needs to be present to show ID when the delivery arrives. Most DC delivery services operate within a set radius and have a minimum order requirement.

Lifted Shop delivers across Washington, DC, from our location at 2622 Georgia Ave NW, with an estimated delivery time of 1 to 2 hours. We also offer pickup at our Georgia Ave NW location for buyers who prefer to collect in person. Hours are daily 10 am to 9 pm, with a $100 minimum for DC delivery.

Best for:

  • People who want cannabis brought to their home, office, or hotel
  • Buyers who know what they want and do not need to browse in person
  • Anyone who wants to avoid travel, parking, or queues
  • Visitors to DC who are staying somewhere with a delivery address
  • People ordering outside of the dispensary’s walk-in hours

Things to keep in mind:

  • Delivery windows typically run 1 to 2 hours, so it is not instant
  • A minimum order applies
  • You need a valid DC delivery address and someone present to receive
  • You are browsing a menu online rather than seeing products in person

Which Option Is Right for You?

There is no universally better option. It comes down to your situation.

If you are new to cannabis and want to ask questions in person, a dispensary staffed by knowledgeable professionals might be a better starting point. If you already know what you want and prefer the convenience of having it brought to you, delivery is the more practical choice for most buyers.

If you are visiting DC and staying at a hotel or rental, delivery is often the easiest option since you do not need to know the city or figure out transport.

If you want to try before you commit to delivery, Lifted Shop also offers pickup at 2622 Georgia Ave NW. You order online, we have it ready, and you collect at your convenience without any browsing or waiting around.
